title: SharedMemberStatusChangeRequest
description: Request to change the status of a shared workflow's members.

workflowIds.description: Member workflow ids to move. At most 500 entries; blanks are rejected and duplicates removed (first occurrence wins), so a repeated id is moved once.

timelineEventData.description: Timeline event to apply to each member; its name is the target status.

memberReasons.description: Optional change reason per member, keyed by workflow id. A member with an entry uses it; the others use timelineEventData.changeReason. Every key must also be in workflowIds.

progressionReason.description: The reason to move past the open PSV blockers. At most 1000 characters.

acknowledgedCoverKeys.description: Cover keys of the open PSV blockers this move goes past, as the progression read returned them. Request-only, never stored. At most 500 non-blank entries.

hiddenCoverKeys.description: Cover keys of the open blockers to hide from the PSV packet: on a move to PSV Complete (the gate writes the mark on the stored covered blockers), or on a single-tenant Withdraw / Cancel before PSV Complete (from GET {workflowId}/psv-progression). Request-only, never stored. Refused on the bulk route; ignored when PSV transparency is off for the tenant. At most 100 non-blank entries.

hiddenFindingRuleKeys.description: Single-tenant Withdraw / Cancel at PSV Complete: the full desired set of non-clean reasons (finding rule keys) hidden from the packet. Absent leaves the marks as they are; an empty list removes every mark; a key that is not a finding is ignored. Request-only. Ignored at PSV Ready or later and when PSV transparency is off for the tenant; refused on the bulk route. At most 100 non-blank entries.

MemberReason.description: One member's own change reason, and for a single-member request its hide choices.

changeReason.description: This member's change reason; at most 1000 characters.

hiddenCoverKeys.description: Cover keys to hide from the packet. Allowed only when the request moves exactly one workflow; at most 100 non-blank entries.

hiddenFindingRuleKeys.description: The full desired set of non-clean reasons (finding rule keys) hidden from the packet. Absent leaves the marks as they are; an empty list removes every mark. Allowed only when the request moves exactly one workflow; at most 100 non-blank entries.

acknowledgedCoverKeys.description: CP-42729: cover keys of the open PSV blockers this reason moves past, as the progression read returned them. Allowed with any number of members; at most 500 non-blank entries. When the open blockers are not all among them the member is refused with BLOCKERS_CHANGED.
